items.title: Hal Espinosa interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 20, 2024
items.q: Jimmy Campbell was the drummer the whole time I was on Woody’s band until I left and that’s when he left and then Jake Hanna came in. So — and then Phil Wilson came in too I think.

ctx.x: But Jimmy Campbell was the drummer the whole time I was on Woody’s band until I left and that’s when he left and then Jake Hanna came in. So — and then Phil Wilson came in too I think. Jimmy went — left probably just after I did.
Were you surprised years later when Bill Chase had success in the rock world?
